theme: 3 terms for tabs in SwiftUI: the container, the icon and the chosen tab

terms.definition: A container that shows one area at a time and lets the user switch with a bar.
terms.example: Use a TabView for Home, Search and Profile.

terms.definition: The icon and the title that a child view shows in the tab bar.
terms.example: Add a Tab Item with a house icon.

terms.definition: The value that decides which tab is shown.
terms.example: Store the Tab Selection in State, so you can switch tabs from code.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to build a tab bar in SwiftUI: TabView, Tab Item & Tab Selection, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
TabView - A container that shows one area at a time and lets the user switch with a bar.
Tab Item - The icon and the title that a child view shows in the tab bar.
Tab Selection - The value that decides which tab is shown.

landscape.hook: Can you explain TabView, Tab Item and Tab Selection in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my app needs three main areas, like Home and Search.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a TabView. It shows one area at a time, with a bar at the bottom.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I put an icon on each tab?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Tab Item to each child view. It defines the icon in the bar.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I forgot the Tab Item on the second area, and the tab looked empty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Every child of the TabView needs its own Tab Item.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I switch tabs from code?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, use a Tab Selection. Give each child a `tag`, then bind the TabView to a value.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So changing the value changes the tab.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. The Tab Selection can be a number, like `1` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the bar also show which tab is selected?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, the TabView highlights the tab that matches the Tab Selection.
Use a TabView for the main areas.
